message: headerFactory hot-potato: /goal-reset pulled the factory out of the PhaseIndicatorHandle via getHeaderFactory() only to hand it back to clearPhaseSurfaces(); getHeaderFactory existed on the public interface solely for this one consumer.
resolution: getHeaderFactory() deleted from the public interface; handle.clearSurfaces(ctx) closes over the module-local headerFactory; clearPhaseSurfaces is now a private module function.

message: Dead imports PhaseArtifact and PHASE_ORDER in dashboard.ts post-refactor.
clearPhaseSurfaces and the null-state branch of pushSurfaces duplicated the same three clear calls.
resolution: Single private clearPhaseSurfaces helper now serves both call sites.

message: interval.unref?.() lacked the mandated WHY comment.
resolution: Added: UI-only timer must not pin the Node event loop in headless/one-shot sessions.

message: Comment at clearPhaseSurfaces misdescribed the reset mechanism.
resolution: Reworded: clear() appends no event, so the version feed never fires after /goal-reset — hence the imperative clear.

message: Two teardown paths: session_shutdown inlined clearInterval while handle.stop() (test-only caller) did more.
resolution: Single teardown() body shared by the session_shutdown handler and stop().

message: phaseIndicator?: PhaseIndicatorHandle optional parameter in three register* signatures was always provided by index.ts.
resolution: Parameter now required in registerGoalRuntimeCommands, registerDashboardCommands, registerHarnessUi; ?. chains dropped; Test 29 passes a stub handle.

message: A5 rendered-percent evidence gap: nothing asserted the modal's 'Progress: {pct}%' line renders; DashboardComponent was not exported.
resolution: DashboardComponent exported; Test 37 asserts the rendered line.

message: Static HarnessDashboard lost its 'Active goal' line despite §4.2(d) declaring it out of scope; deletion is consistent with G6 single-ownership but is a visible behavior change beyond the letter of the spec.
resolution: Accepted as scope-creep in the right direction; recorded here as the changelog note.
